newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DBS Land to issue statement.
newsitem.headline: DBS Land to issue statement.

text.p: Property group DBS Land Ltd will issue a statement on Tuesday, a company spokeswoman said.
She declined to say what the statement would be about.
DBS Land's shares were suspended on Tuesday morning at the company's request.
Dealers said there had been market rumours the company could be interested in buying a stake in property and hospital group Parkway Holdings. DBS Land has identified healthcare as a core business.
The daily Straits Times on Tuesday quoted market speculation that DBS Land may be about to buy Kuala Lumpur-listed Hospital Pantai's 19 percent stake in Parkway.
But some analysts dismissed the rumours as unfounded because Parkway shares had not been suspended.
By 0430 GMT, Parkway shares were down 25 cents at Singapore $6.25 with 221,000 traded.
Parkway officials were not immediately available for comment.
